chapter: Police work, brass bands and carnival
title: Deputy sheriff commission and bond-breaker pay
summary: He explains his special officer and deputy sheriff commissions, that he is auxiliary rather than salaried, and how he is paid for catching bond breakers, with an anecdote about a trombone sale.
